story_overview: In a sterile, oppressive facility, Fiona and Leo attempt a cautious escape, monitored by security cameras. Meanwhile, Anya and Silas work from a cluttered workshop, seemingly part of a larger plan involving hiding in laundry carts, as tensions rise between the captives and their unseen observers.
